input.title: Run and summarize all DTDM_Unet experiments and speech metrics
input.description:
Operate on /mnt/parscratch/users/acp23xt/private/DTDM_Unet. A subfolder means a first-depth subfolder of that repository.

1. Discover every first-depth subfolder containing run.sh and submit its run.sh with sbatch. Record every job ID. Do not include folders without run.sh.
2. Wait for each run job to finish successfully. For each run.sh, invoke /mnt/parscratch/users/acp23xt/private/DTDM_Unet/extract_metrics_paths.py with that run.sh path. It may emit multiple gen/out pairs for Hydra sweeps; process every emitted pair, not only the last. Update that subfolder's metrics.sh gen and out assignments for each pair and submit metrics.sh. Preserve the established gt path and metric commands. Record the mapping and job IDs.
3. Read /mnt/parscratch/users/acp23xt/private/codex_whisper/NOTES.md. For every gen directory emitted in step 2, compute per-WAV WER using Whisper large-v3 and the specified transcript. Submit GPU Slurm jobs using the established codex_whisper scripts/tools; write stem_wer_l.txt beside each WAV.
4. Read /mnt/parscratch/users/acp23xt/private/codex_utmosv2/NOTES.md. For every gen directory emitted in step 2, compute UTMOSv2 using the established codex_utmosv2 environment/tools in GPU Slurm jobs; write stem_utmosv2.txt beside each WAV.
5. Wait for all metrics, WER, and UTMOSv2 jobs to succeed. Validate expected output coverage against the WAV count in each gen directory. For each gen path, summarize MCD, logF0/F0, WER, and UTMOSv2 with sample count, arithmetic mean, and standard deviation. Inspect the actual metric output formats rather than assuming them. Save a machine-readable CSV and a readable Markdown report under /mnt/parscratch/users/acp23xt/private/DTDM_Unet/.symphony/results/. Include folder, sweep/gen path, metric counts, means, standard deviations, Slurm job IDs, and any genuine missing values.

Use dependency-aware Slurm jobs or short scheduler polling for orchestration. Never do long computation or a long sleep loop on the Symphony host. Check sacct exit states and logs. Retry safe transient failures and report persistent failures accurately. Preserve pre-existing dirty-tree work. Keep a single Linear workpad comment current, post the final report there, and move the issue to Done only after all requested outputs and summaries are complete.
